action_items: (Cosmetic, non-blocking) RN Web emits deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props and props.pointerEvents — coming from BrutalCard / Modal helpers. Migrate to boxShadow + style.pointerEvents at convenience.

(Test ergonomics) /game/[id].tsx is a Stack route outside (tabs) so the bottom tab bar is not present during play — clicking tab x/y won't navigate. Tests should call router.replace('/(tabs)/home') via testIDs (result-home-btn, play-back-btn or game-back-btn) before tapping tabs.
critical_code_review_comments: Ionicons font preload in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx via useFonts(Ionicons.font) is correctly gated on fontsLoaded||fontError — no early render of icons; SplashScreen.hideAsync() is awaited via setHidden hook. This eliminates the 'Font file for ionicons is empty' crash on Expo Go iOS as intended.
useFocusEffect in manage.tsx and settings.tsx returns a cleanup that resets unlocked=false — correct auto-lock-on-blur pattern. Verified empirically.
PremiumRow conditionally renders lock-closed vs chevron based on `unlocked` prop fed by state.isPremium — clean.
wallet-warn-modal uses Modal+TouchableWithoutFeedback nested pattern correctly: outside tap closes (verified), inside tap is swallowed by inner TWF wrapping the modalCard.
seed_data_creation: None — AsyncStorage / localStorage only; cleared at start of run.

Visibility-filtered selectors are required because Expo Router keeps stale screens in DOM. Math Quiz auto-advances after 800ms post-tap; the green feedback color is rgb(209,250,229) (successSoft). Premium pass via premium-pass-btn unlocks state.isPremium across the app. Outside-tap dismiss tested at coords (20,50) which is above the modal card. Game start screen wraps '60%' in nested Text — selector must allow children when matching parent textContent.
